_README: THE LIVE MENU. Its presence is the ON switch for Mr. Cadabra's floating layer.
Delete this file and he is off everywhere, with no page change and no flag.
SCOPE, ON PURPOSE: only 'demo' is listed below. cadabra.js refuses to mount on a
page the menu does not name (PRESENCE_RULES.md rule 18), so session.html stays
completely dark even though it is wired -- add a 'session' block here when you
are ready to watch him in a real lesson, and not before.
Adding a NEW behaviour is code (see BEHAVIOURS in cadabra.js).
Scheduling one is editing this file.

demo._note: The demo drives him directly from its own eleven-stop tour via Cadabra.point(), so there are no scheduled moments here. This block exists so he is allowed to mount on the demo at all.
